quantity_downsizing_attribution.explanation: Wider structural/Unicorn stops in Variants B, C, and D automatically reduce position quantity to maintain the fixed $2.50 risk budget AND filter out setups where wider stop distance lowers Net R:R < 1.50. Experiment 1 (matched_sl_only_comparison) isolates the pure SL effect on the identical cohort where both compared variants pass eligibility.
